description: Moves price formatting to Intl.NumberFormat; the bug drops the null guard that an earlier fix added, so items that are not on sale show $0.00, the clean diff drops it too but the only caller now handles a missing sale price.

history.message: feat: show list and sale prices in the cart

fix: show a dash for items that are not on sale (#64)

formatPrice(null) threw a TypeError and broke the cart for any item without a sale price.

bug.scenario: The Pencil case has salePrice null in src/catalog.js; cartRows calls formatPrice(null), and Intl.NumberFormat formats null as 0, so the cart shows a sale price of $0.00 instead of the dash the guard returned.

clean.why_safe: src/cart.js, the only caller that can pass null, now writes the dash itself when salePrice is null and calls formatPrice only with a number; item.price is always set.
